sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Jack of All Trades - Pro is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "So, how are things going with the classes in the Arena? Yeah, I remember you already reported in, but the conditions back then were easier. Now I want to see how much you've grown since then. Put on a show on the main stage!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Win a round as Assault in BlastGang or TeamFight mode
- Win a round as Enforcer in BlastGang or TeamFight mode
- Win a round as Scout in BlastGang or TeamFight mode
- Win a round as Marksman in BlastGang or TeamFight mode

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +12,000 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.01
- 64,400 Roubles
- 36 GP coins
